extracted.intended_audience: scientists, academics, and academic/job applicants (universities, research institutes, and professional societies)
extracted.subtask_description: Compilation of eligibility, application, selection, and appointment terms and standards extracted from university and institutional vacancy notices and society reports in a scientific weekly. Focuses on what institutions require, prefer, and use to evaluate candidates and appointments.

rubrics_metrics.name: Weather-prediction success threshold
rubrics_metrics.description: If the forecast is drawn in precise terms, weather prediction may be considered satisfactory if the proportion of successes is more than 60 per cent.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Forecasts that are vague or cover many possibilities are not useful; precision is a precondition for judging success, and >60% correct is given as a practical benchmark for satisfactory performance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Indian Agricultural Service selection criteria (eligibility and weighting)
rubrics_metrics.description: In filling the appointments weight will be attached to the possession of University Degrees or Agricultural Diplomas and practical experience; but practical experience alone is insufficient. Candidates must be between 23 and 30 years of age. For the appointments in Burma Indians will not be eligible.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Selection is based on formal academic qualifications plus practical experience; age limits apply; nationality restrictions may apply for certain posts (e.g., Burma). Pay scales and allowances vary by domicile and service record.

rubrics_metrics.name: University of Hong-Kong Lecturer (mechanical engineering) requirements and terms
rubrics_metrics.description: Candidates should be graduates in Engineering of some British University. Preference will be given to unmarried men. A sound knowledge of workshop practice, ability to take students in steam and oil engine work and to lecture on practical subjects, is required. The Lecturer will be expected to keep all the plant of the Laboratories in running order. The appointment will be on a five years’ agreement. Salary 4500 per annum, converted for purposes of local payment ... Free quarters or an allowance of £100. Half salary from date of embarkation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Emphasises formal degree, practical workshop skills, hands-on maintenance responsibilities, specific teaching capabilities (steam/oil engines), fixed-term appointment length, and detailed financial/embarkation arrangements (salary conversion, quarters/allowance, half salary while travelling).

rubrics_metrics.name: Preference for commissioned officers / service-related allowances
rubrics_metrics.description: Preference will be given to candidates who have served as commissioned officers in any of the three Services. In the case of appointments to Grade III an allowance up to ten increments of the scale can be granted in respect of previous experience and war service.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prior commissioned service and war service are explicit positive selection factors and can be translated into higher initial salary increments or preferential appointment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Subject and instructional requirements for Civilian Education Staff (RAF)
rubrics_metrics.description: The subjects of instruction include English, Practical Mathematics, Mechanics, Elementary Thermodynamics, Electricity and Drawing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Vacancies specify exact subject-matter competence required; applicants are expected to be able to teach these named subjects (practical and theoretical).

rubrics_metrics.name: Application materials and testimonial requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Applications, together with copies of testimonials as to qualifications, experience, and character, all in duplicate (or specified numbers of copies), must be lodged with the Secretary by specified deadlines. Examples: 'Applications ... should be sent ... with three testimonials' ; 'Applications ... with two copies of not more than three recent testimonials' ; 'Forms of Application and further particulars may be obtained ...'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Institutions specify the number and type of testimonial copies, require testimonials addressing qualifications/experience/character, and provide/require specific application forms and submission addresses and deadlines. Meeting these procedural requirements is necessary for consideration.

rubrics_metrics.name: Federated Superannuation / pension system membership requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: In both cases the applicant appointed must join the Federated Superannuation System for Universities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Appointment may be conditional on joining institutional/sector pension schemes; candidates should be prepared to enrol where required.

rubrics_metrics.name: Medical qualification not essential (for certain scientific posts)
rubrics_metrics.description: A Medical qualification is not an essential condition of either appointment (Assistant Lecturer in Bacteriology; Demonstrator in Bacteriology).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For some scientific posts connected with medicine/public health, formal medical degrees are not mandatory—academic/research credentials may suffice.

rubrics_metrics.name: Swansea Science Mistress qualification requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: Candidates must be Graduates of a British University with qualifications in Physics.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies national university graduation and subject-specific qualification as baseline eligibility for the post.

rubrics_metrics.name: Isle of Wight Assistant Master appointment criteria
rubrics_metrics.description: Applicants should be Graduates, preferably in Honours, and should state what subsidiary subjects they can offer. Willingness to take part in out-of-school activities will be a strong recommendation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Emphasises degree-level education (honours preferred), teaching breadth (subsidiary subjects), and extracurricular engagement as positive selection factors.

rubrics_metrics.name: University of London (King’s College) Assistant Lecturer application condition
rubrics_metrics.description: The Delegacy require the services of an Assistant Lecturer in Physics; Applications, with two copies of not more than three recent testimonials, should be received not later than [date]; Opportunities will be given for research work.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies testimonial number/format and highlights that research opportunity is part of the post (a positive attractor for research-oriented candidates).

rubrics_metrics.name: Witwatersrand vacancies — passage, salary, and appointment terms
rubrics_metrics.description: Professor of Philosophy: £860 per annum on scale £860-30-1100. —Allowance of £60 towards passage expenses. In addition, in both cases a free first-class ticket is provided from Cape Town to Johannesburg, and half-salary is paid during the voyage. Duties commence on March 1, 1923. Applications ... not later than November 22, 1922.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Institutions state explicit salary scales, travel allowances, travel salary arrangements (half salary during voyage), start dates, and firm application deadlines; these terms form part of the evaluation/acceptance decision for candidates considering the post.

rubrics_metrics.name: Preference for subject-specialist graduates for curatorial posts
rubrics_metrics.description: The Council of the Manchester University invite applications for the post of KEEPER of the MUSEUM. Preference will be given to candidates who are University graduates in Natural History subjects.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Curatorial/keeper posts favour candidates with university credentials in the museum's subject area; being a subject-specialist graduate is an explicit positive criterion.

rubrics_metrics.name: Procedural requirement: use of official application forms and where to obtain particulars
rubrics_metrics.description: Forms of application may be obtained from the undersigned / Secretary / Office named, from whom further particulars may be obtained. Applications must be lodged with the named office by specified dates.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants are expected to follow institutional procedures: obtain the official form, supply requested documentation, and submit to the named administrative contact by the deadline; failure to follow procedure can disqualify an application.
